say:1:1130415001:1.text: Although you're welcome here, this place is currently unsuitable for pilgrims.
say:1:1130415001:1.source_cn: 虽然欢迎你们来到这里，但这里现在并不适合朝拜者。
say:1:1130415001:1.male: Although you're welcome here, this place is currently unsuitable for pilgrims.
say:1:1130415001:1.female: Although you're welcome here, this place is currently unsuitable for pilgrims.

say:2:1130415002:1.text: To avoid any accidents or mishaps, please don't linger long.
say:2:1130415002:1.source_cn: 为了避免出现意外和纠纷，请不要在这附近逗留。
say:2:1130415002:1.male: To avoid any accidents or mishaps, please don't linger long.
say:2:1130415002:1.female: To avoid any accidents or mishaps, please don't linger long.

say:4:1130415003:1.text: So you're not here to worship?
say:4:1130415003:1.male: So you're not here to worship?
say:4:1130415003:1.female: So you're not here to worship?

say:5:1130415004:1.text: Pilgrims are those who come to pay respect to the Dusk Lord and Mars Peak.
say:5:1130415004:1.source_cn: 朝拜者是对着残阳神和战神峰怀有敬意的人。
say:5:1130415004:1.male: Pilgrims are those who come to pay respect to the Dusk Lord and Mars Peak.
say:5:1130415004:1.female: Pilgrims are those who come to pay respect to the Dusk Lord and Mars Peak.

say:6:1130415005:1.text: They travel great distances for the honor of ascending the mountain and paying reverence.
say:6:1130415005:1.source_cn: 他们会登上山腰，朝着战神峰远远地朝拜，表达对残阳神和初...
say:6:1130415005:1.male: They travel great distances for the honor of ascending the mountain and paying reverence.
say:6:1130415005:1.female: They travel great distances for the honor of ascending the mountain and paying reverence.

say:7:1130415006:1.text: I admire them greatly. Pilgrims make the journey day after day, year after year.
say:7:1130415006:1.source_cn: 不过我很佩服他们，他们日复一日年复一年地来到这里朝拜。
say:7:1130415006:1.male: I admire them greatly. Pilgrims make the journey day after day, year after year.
say:7:1130415006:1.female: I admire them greatly. Pilgrims make the journey day after day, year after year.
